import pytest
from subject import _extract_frames, compute_error_fingerprint


def test_extract_frames_basic():
    traceback = '''Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "pkg_a/foo.py", line 10, in bar
    raise ValueError()
  File "pkg_a/baz.py", line 20, in qux
    bar()'''
    frames = _extract_frames(traceback)
    assert frames == ["pkg_a/foo.py:bar", "pkg_a/baz.py:qux"]


def test_extract_frames_uses_last_two_path_components():
    traceback = '''  File "src/omni/core/engine.py", line 5, in start
    run()
  File "src/omni/core/runner.py", line 10, in run
    execute()'''
    frames = _extract_frames(traceback)
    assert frames == ["core/engine.py:start", "core/runner.py:run"]
